text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I notice Narita Taishin
near the
station. She must've just
finished something,
because she's
heading back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hang on, isn't there supposed to be a limited-edition Animal Hunt character that spawns around here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I might as well catch it while I have the
chance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I don't see it on the radar—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Bwah?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What the—?! "Wet concrete. Please
watch your
step"?!

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, miss. I think your boot's done for.
Such a
shame.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Oops.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Great, now I only have one boot. How
am I
supposed to get home barefoot?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.
choice_data_list: あれ？タイシン？
choice_data_list_en: Huh? Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you know this little lady? She
stuck her
foot straight into the wet
concrete.

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
Good thing your friend's here now, miss!
Take
care getting home!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin is bright red with
embarrassment as
the construction
worker waves goodbye and
leaves.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I need help or anything.
Leave me
alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, it's clear that
she'll have
trouble getting back to her
dorm on her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, it's clear that
she'll have
trouble getting back to her
dorm on her own.
choice_data_list: 俺が靴を買ってくるよ
私が靴を買ってくるよ
靴屋まで肩を貸すよ
choice_data_list_en: I'll go buy the shoes.
I'll go buy some shoes.
I'll lend you a shoulder to the shoe store.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You got wax in your ears? I said I don't
need your
help.
choice_data_list: 俺が靴を買ってくるよ
私が靴を買ってくるよ
靴屋まで肩を貸すよ
choice_data_list_en: I'll go buy the shoes.
I'll go buy some shoes.
I'll lend you a shoulder to the shoe store.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: N-no! That'll just make things worse!
choice_data_list: じゃあ寮に連絡するか？
じゃあ寮に連絡する？
choice_data_list_en: Then should I contact the dorm?
Then should we contact the dorm?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh. Fine. Here, take this money and get me new shoes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since I got her permission, I bring her to
a nearby
park to wait for me, then rush
to a shoe shop.

text_block_list.name: Shoe Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
Young people these days love this style!
They're
also great to run in, so I highly
recommend them!

text_block_list.name: Shoe Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
And since you mentioned it earlier,
these shoes
go great with street fashion
too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I figure I can't go wrong with shoes that
have the
employee's seal of approval, so
I buy the pair she
recommends.
choice_data_list: なるほど……
choice_data_list_en: I see...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, I run back to Narita Taishin
and show
her the new shoes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, thanks. You're a lifesav—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What the hell's with this cutesy
nonsense?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
These aren't my style at all! You should
know
better!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Now you're just admitting you got
conned by a
sales pitch. Ugh, whatever. I
guess I'll put them
on.
choice_data_list: ストリートファッションにも合うらしいぞ
ストリートファッションにも合うらしいよ
choice_data_list_en: I hear it goes well with street fashion, too.
I hear it goes well with street fashion, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Huh... These actually don't feel so bad
once you
put them on.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Urgh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't need your flattery. As long as
they don't
look weird, they're fine.
choice_data_list: 似合ってるぞ、タイシン！
似合ってるよ、タイシン！
choice_data_list_en: It suits you, Taishin!
Looking good, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin seems indifferent about
her new
shoes, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Taishin? Heading out somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you really like those new
shoes of
yours! ♪ They look amazing
with your outfit
today!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Y-you think?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah... I guess they do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely not! I'd rather hop there on
my own
than lean on you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hup... Gah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin attempts to hop her way
over but
loses balance after a few
bounds.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, fine.
choice_data_list: やっぱり危ない！掴まってくれ！
やっぱり危ない！掴まって！
choice_data_list_en: It's too dangerous! Hold onto me!
It's too dangerous! Hold on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She reluctantly grabs hold of my
shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After walking for a while together, we
come
across a park and decide to rest on
a bench.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Playing a game. One of those
location-based
ones.
choice_data_list: そういえばあそこで何していたんだ？
そういえばあそこで何していたの？
choice_data_list_en: Come to think of it, what were you doing over there?
Come to think of it, what were you doing over there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The game involves finding and capturing

characters that are projected into the
real world
via augmented reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She had been trying to catch a
limited-edition
character when I saw her
in front of the station.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: As if it'd be that—
choice_data_list: なら歩いているうちに見つかるかもな
なら歩いているうちに見つかるかもね
choice_data_list_en: Then maybe we'll find it while we're walking.
Then maybe we'll find it while we're walking.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No way! There's a blip on the radar!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the character she's after has
actually
appeared. She tells me its
coordinates, which
aren't too far from
where we are now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: すぐ近くだし行こう！
choice_data_list_en: It's super close by, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hm...
choice_data_list: 靴がダメになった鬱憤を晴らすんだ！
靴がダメになった鬱憤を晴らすんだよ！
choice_data_list_en: I'm venting my frustration over my ruined shoes!
We're venting our frustration over our ruined shoes!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's not a bad way to look at it. It'd
suck to go
back with a bad taste in my
mouth because of
that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All right. I'm definitely gonna catch it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin nods, and I lend her my
shoulder
again. We head off to where
the character has
appeared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our teamwork pays off, and Narita
Taishin
manages to capture the
limited-edition character.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks. I guess I do feel a little
better.
choice_data_list: おめでとう、タイシン！
choice_data_list_en: Congratulations, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finally arrived at a shop, Narita
Taishin
buys new shoes. She seems to be
in a better mood
when we part.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've grown a little closer to
Narita
Taishin after working together
with her.
